metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Studio Moser — strategy, research, and product development tools.

plugins.name: product-pulse
plugins.description: Strategic intelligence system for product teams. Weekly strategy briefs, daily market research, and interactive sprint development — a three-cadence system that keeps you focused on what matters.

plugins.name: research-scout
plugins.description: Deep-dive research and analysis of external reference materials (YouTube videos, articles, GitHub repos, docs) against your current project. Goes beyond summaries — cross-references findings with your codebase and delivers specific, actionable recommendations.

plugins.name: site-capture
plugins.description: Capture full-page screenshots of websites with scroll-triggered animation support. Handles bot-protected sites, cookie banners, and lazy-loaded content.
